title: Negotiate the Mortgage, Not Just the Price
subtitle: Unlock the potential of seller flexibility by focusing on strategic mortgage structuring, not just price cuts. Leverage UFF's expertise to empower your buyers.
keyTakeaways: Identify buyer priorities: payment reduction, cash to close, or reserves.
Model financing options comparing price reduction vs. seller-paid costs.
Use seller concessions on closing costs, discount points, or buydowns.
Collaborate with Realtors to craft impactful offers.
Utilize UFF's PRO Portal for streamlined loan origination and scenario modeling.

sections.heading: Understand Buyer Goals
sections.body: Start by identifying what your buyer values most—whether it's lower monthly payments, reduced cash to close, or preserving their reserves. These goals will guide your negotiation strategy.
bullets: Discuss with the buyer's agent to ascertain priorities.
Focus on long-term financial benefits rather than immediate price reductions.

sections.heading: Model Financing Scenarios
sections.body: Utilize the PRO Portal to create and compare various loan scenarios. Determine how a $10,000 concession can be maximized through closing cost coverage, discount points, or temporary buydowns.
bullets: Use PRO Portal's pricing tools to evaluate multiple scenarios.
Customize worksheets to reflect different buyer needs and market conditions.

sections.heading: Collaborate with Realtors
sections.body: Share your financing insights with the Realtor to help them craft a compelling offer. Emphasize the strategic use of seller concessions over mere price reductions to enhance buyer affordability.
bullets: Communicate clearly how financing adjustments benefit the buyer.
Work together to present a unified, attractive offer to sellers.

sections.heading: Leverage UFF's Expertise
sections.body: As a UFF partner, you have access to a range of loan products and expert scenario desk support. Use these resources to confidently structure loans that align with market conditions and client needs.
bullets: Explore UFF's portfolio: Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, Non-QM, and more.
Consult with UFF's scenario desk for complex or unique borrower situations.

metaDescription: Shift focus from price cuts to strategic mortgage structuring with UFF's guidance. Maximize buyer affordability today.
